apps.versionDescription: Spotify Core v0.60.9 (Modified by Ares) — Built on Spotify 9.1.90: Spoof Premium now displays localized Premium Individual / Personnel in Your Premium and the sidebar drawer (including Free accounts) while hiding the Trial badge and expiration date line even on active trial accounts.
apps.localizedDescription: Spotify Core (Modified by Ares) built on Spotify 9.1.90: 20 custom app icons in Appearance -> App icon (iOS 16.1+ & iOS 26+), curated first-install defaults, Liquid Glass UI (iOS 26+) & Legacy UI (iOS 16.1+), built-in Spotify Premium & ad-blocking, synced lyrics & Sing mode, offline downloads, Audio DSP, AutoMix, Live Activity, and Open in Spotify Core Safari extension.
